lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular clusters arranged in localized nodes posterior to the branchial region, forming a roughly grid-like spatial distribution across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical segments of elevated luminance intersecting horizontal rows of circular clusters to form discrete anchor nodes of high contrast.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear horizontal features showing a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition, with illuminated dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-frequency distribution of small, lower-luminance speckles compared to the primary flank patterning.
